title: 第8章 不速之客
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

江蓠的手微微发抖。

她不是没见过钱，在杀戮之都的十二年，从死人身上扒下来的财物加起来也有几万金魂币。

可那是无数次用险死还生换来的。

而眼前这些……

“多少？”不等她从震惊中清醒过来，古榕的声音已经从对面传来，语气里带着几分明知故问的戏谑。

“……几十万。”江蓠的喉结动了动，声音有些干涩。

古榕嘴角微勾，一副不出所料的表情。

“风致做事，什么时候小气过？”

江蓠沉默了。

缓缓将神识从储物魂导器中退出，心情说不清是复杂还是荒谬。

这钱，拿在手里，她心里只觉得沉甸甸的。

正在这时，门外忽然响起一阵敲门声。

“笃笃笃。”

三声，不急不缓，很规矩。

江蓠收拢心绪，淡淡开口。

“进。”

门被推开，一名中年男人快步走了进来。

此人身材魁梧，肩膀宽阔，手指粗壮有力，指节上满是老茧和烫伤的痕迹。

来人面相方正，目光沉稳，进门后先是微微打量了一眼屋内两人，旋即躬身行了一礼。

“两位贵客，在下思龙，铁匠协会楼高会长的弟子，老师吩咐，由我招待二位。”

古榕微微睁开了眼，上下打量了一番，没有说话。

思龙直起身，从怀中取出一份折好的清单，双手递了过来。

“会长吩咐，二位的住处已经安排妥当。另外，这份是今晚拍卖会的拍品清单，会长说，二位或许用得上。”

江蓠接过清单，展开扫了一眼，目光很快锁定了最后一行。

八宝如意软甲，底价十万金魂币。

果然在。

“此外，”思龙又补充道。

“此刻已近午时，不知二位可赏光，让在下做东，吃顿便饭？”

江蓠看了古榕一眼。

古榕摩挲了一下下巴，淡淡道：“客随主便。“

酒店不远，出了铁匠协会，远远就能看到。

三层高的建筑，门口两盏鎏金灯笼，即便白天也透着几分气派。

思龙走在前面引路，刚到前台，掌柜的便迎了上来，满脸堆笑。

“1号包间。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Jiang Li's hands were shaking slightly.

It's not that she hasn't seen money before. In the twelve years she spent in the Killing City, the total amount of property she took from dead people amounted to tens of thousands of gold soul coins.

But that was earned through countless close calls.

And these in front of me...

"How much?" Before she could wake up from the shock, Gu Rong's voice came from the other side, with a hint of knowing teasing in her tone.

"...Hundreds of thousands." Jiang Li's Adam's apple moved, and her voice was a little dry.

The corners of Gu Rong's mouth were slightly raised, with an expected expression.

"When has Fengzhi ever been stingy in doing things?"

Jiang Li was silent.

Slowly withdrawing his consciousness from the storage soul guide, he couldn't tell whether his mood was complicated or ridiculous.

Holding this money in her hand, she felt heavy in her heart.

At this moment, there was a knock on the door.

"Tuk-tuk-tuk."

Three times, no rush, no slowness, very polite.

Jiang Lei collected her thoughts and spoke calmly.

"Come in."

The door was pushed open and a middle-aged man walked in quickly.

The man was tall, with broad shoulders, thick and strong fingers, and his knuckles were covered with calluses and burn marks.

The visitor had a square face and steady eyes. After entering the door, he briefly looked at the two people in the room, then bowed and saluted.

"Two distinguished guests, I am Silong, a disciple of President Lou Gao of the Blacksmith Association. The teacher has asked me to entertain you two."

Gu Rong opened his eyes slightly, looked up and down, but said nothing.

Silong straightened up, took out a folded list from his arms, and handed it over with both hands.

"The president has ordered that your accommodation has been arranged. In addition, this is the list of items for tonight's auction. The president said that you two may be able to use it."

Jiang Li took the list, opened it and glanced at it, her eyes quickly locked on the last line.

The Eight Treasures Ruyi Soft Armor has a base price of 100,000 gold soul coins.

Sure enough, there.

"Besides," Silong added.

"It's almost noon now. I wonder if you two would appreciate the honor and let me cook for you and have a light meal?"

Jiang Li glanced at Gu Rong.

Gu Rong rubbed his chin and said calmly: "The guest does as he pleases."

The hotel is not far away. You can see it from a distance after leaving the Blacksmiths Association.

The three-story building has two gilt lanterns at the door, giving it a certain grandeur even during the day.

Silong walked in front to lead the way. As soon as he arrived at the front desk, the shopkeeper came up to him with a smile on his face.

"Private room No. 1."
